expected_behavior: Acknowledges family visit and highlights non-gaming options

turns.user_message: My family of 5 is visiting next month, including my parents
turns.agent_response:
It is a pleasure to help you plan your family's visit next month. For a group of five, including your parents, I recommend looking into connecting rooms in the Sky Tower. 

Pairing a Deluxe Room with two queen beds and a second room with a king bed ensures everyone has their own space while staying close together. If you would like a bit more room to lounge, our Junior Suites are 650 square feet and feature a king bed plus a pull-out sofa bed, which provides a private retreat where your parents could relax in the expanded soaking tub.

One detail many first-time guests appreciate is that our rooms are designed with floor-to-ceiling windows, offering incredible views of the Thames River or the surrounding Connecticut hills. Our standard check-in time is between 3:00 PM and 4:00 PM, and check-out is at 11:00 AM. Since our front desk is staffed 24 hours a day, we will be ready for you whenever you arrive.

As a hotel guest, you will be just a short walk from over 40 restaurants, including Tuscany for authentic Italian or Michael Jordan's Steak House for a more formal family meal. Will you be celebrating a specific milestone or special occasion during your stay next month?
